overview: A premium full-stack Institute Fee Management Portal for Akshay Classes, featuring role-based dashboards for admins and students, payment tracking, notifications, and beautiful glassmorphism UI with dark/light mode.
features: Internet Identity authentication with admin/student roles
Admin dashboard with stats, charts, and student management
Fee and payment recording with multiple payment methods
Student dashboard with fee summary and payment history
Notification system with manual and auto-triggered alerts
Recharts visualizations for revenue and fee data
Dark/light mode with Framer Motion animations
Responsive mobile layout with animated sidebar
Loading skeletons, empty states, and toast notifications
